selection: Cutoff proposed before data access; retained after training-only timestamp coverage inspection, before any scores.
fit: Labeled training-archive impressions strictly before cutoff. Histories are not counted as popularity clicks.
development: Remaining training-archive impressions; frozen fit counts, no development label updates.
ranking: All logged candidates, popularity and fixed SHA256 hash-order comparator; macro AUC, mean_clicked_rr, first_hit_rr, nDCG@5/10, recall@5/10.
retrieval: Frozen popularity top20/100 among IDs first observed strictly earlier; same-time/future excluded; unavailable positives retained in denominator.
segments: All, fit-unseen user, fit-seen user, and impressions with a positive absent from all fitting candidates; daily ranking.
exclusions: No malformed row silently excluded. Zero-positive ranking ratios and single-class AUC undefined and denominator-reported.
holdout: MINDsmall_dev.zip remains sealed until final project protocol/models frozen.
